title: Make the engram-use skill's export route and memory condition operational, and align the memory import example in git-task-sync.md
outcome: Make the engram-use skill's export route and memory condition operational, and align the memory import example in git-task-sync.md
acceptance: The skill's refresh step copies the basis whenever the export changed .engram/project.json (including a first memory opt-in whose task route is unchanged), and the exports request --json

The skill defines 'the data branch holds memories' as HEAD's .engram/project.json carrying memory_profile (or the project deciding to exchange memories), and says the first --include-memories export on an existing branch is a deliberate opt-in

docs/features/git-task-sync.md and the skill state that import is incremental once this host has imported a committed folder, and that a store's first import (including the first publisher's after only exporting) uses --basis

completion.summary: The engram-use skill now explains the --json export receipt, project.json memory-profile condition and deliberate first memory opt-in; the skill and git-task-sync.md document incremental later imports and --basis for a store's first import. The combined docs candidate was fast-forwarded to origin/master and installed, all six live stores reported ready, and the independent post-landing acceptance evaluation passed all 3 criteria.
